intro.en: Trailer harnesses connect the towing vehicle with semi-trailers, utility trailers, equipment carriers, dump trailers, campers, boat trailers and agricultural trailers. The category includes front interface leads, complete chassis looms, lighting branches, brake and ABS/EBS circuits, axle leads, breakaway and battery circuits, liftgate or hydraulic power branches, reefer connections and rear-door assemblies.
intro.zh: 拖车线束连接牵引车与半挂车、通用拖车、设备运输拖车、自卸拖车、露营拖车、船用拖车及农业拖车。该小类覆盖前端连接线、完整底盘主线束、灯光分支、制动与 ABS/EBS 回路、车轴引线、脱离制动与蓄电池回路、尾板或液压动力分支、冷藏机组连接及后门组件。

knowledge.en: A trailer harness is not one universal cable. Connector family, regional interface, system voltage, circuit count, trailer length, axle and brake architecture, installed equipment and exposure determine the released design. A plug that mates mechanically does not prove pin assignment, current capacity, grounding, network compatibility or environmental performance.
knowledge.zh: 拖车线束不是一根通用电缆。连接器家族、地区接口、系统电压、回路数量、拖车长度、车轴与制动架构、安装设备及暴露环境共同决定放行设计。插头能够机械插合，并不能证明针脚定义、载流能力、接地、网络兼容性或环境性能。

notes.en: Provide towing vehicle and trailer type; market and applicable interface standard; system voltage; connector and mating-part data; circuit table and loads; lighting, brake, ABS/EBS and auxiliary equipment; trailer length, axle count and articulation points; chassis route photographs; clips and pass-throughs; water, salt, mud, UV and washdown exposure; drawings or sample; labels; quantity; and required validation.
notes.zh: 请提供牵引车与拖车类型、销售市场及适用接口标准、系统电压、连接器与对插件资料、回路表与负载、灯光、制动、ABS/EBS 及辅助设备信息、拖车长度、车轴数量与铰接点、底盘走线照片、卡扣与穿孔、水、盐、泥浆、紫外线及冲洗暴露、图纸或样品、标签、数量与所需验证。

delivery.en: Approved requirements become controlled drawings, circuit and pin tables, BOMs, cut lists, splice maps, route datums, protection instructions, labels and test programs. First articles are checked for mating, reach, articulation, chassis clearance, lamp and equipment function and agreed vehicle behavior before repeat production. Records remain linked to trailer configuration and drawing revision.
delivery.zh: 批准需求会转化为受控图纸、回路与针脚表、物料表、裁线表、接续图、走线基准、防护工艺、标签与测试程序。重复生产前检查首件的对插、可达、铰接、底盘间隙、灯具与设备功能及约定车辆行为，记录持续关联拖车配置和图纸版本。

introduction.en: Build the Electrical Route from Tow Interface to Every Trailer Zone
introduction.zh: 从牵引接口到拖车各区域建立完整电气路径

subtitle.en: Tow interfaces, lighting, brakes, ABS/EBS, auxiliary power and exposed chassis routing
subtitle.zh: 覆盖牵引接口、灯光、制动、ABS/EBS、辅助电源与裸露底盘走线

lead.en: Trailer wiring is a family of complete and modular assemblies. The correct architecture follows the towing interface, trailer function, installed options, chassis movement, exposure and service strategy.
lead.zh: 拖车布线是一套完整与模块化组件家族。正确架构必须服从牵引接口、拖车功能、安装选项、底盘运动、暴露环境与维修策略。

title.en: One category covers road trailers, work trailers and specialised equipment bodies
title.zh: 同一小类覆盖道路拖车、作业拖车与专用设备车体

copy.en: Semi-trailers, box and curtain-side trailers, flatbeds, low-loaders, tippers, tankers, utility trailers, campers, boat trailers and agricultural equipment divide wiring into different service zones. A project may need one complete loom or separate front, chassis, axle, lighting, door, liftgate, hydraulic, reefer and sensor assemblies. Module boundaries follow manufacturing sequence, body-builder interfaces and field replacement needs rather than arbitrary cable length.
copy.zh: 半挂车、厢式与侧帘车、平板车、低平板车、自卸车、罐车、通用拖车、露营拖车、船用拖车与农业设备会把布线划分为不同维修区域。项目可以是一根完整主线束，也可以拆分为前端、底盘、车轴、灯光、车门、尾板、液压、冷藏与传感组件；模块边界服从制造顺序、上装接口与现场更换需求，而不是任意线长。

copy.en: Length, axle group, doors, ramps, lift systems and auxiliary equipment change the released assembly.
copy.zh: 长度、车轴组、车门、坡道、举升系统与辅助设备都会改变放行组件。

copy.en: Disconnect points should support realistic installation and replacement.
copy.zh: 断开点应支持真实装配与现场更换。

title.en: Connector format and pin assignment must match the actual market and vehicle architecture
title.zh: 连接器形式与针脚定义必须匹配实际市场和车辆架构

copy.en: Light-duty trailers may use four-, five-, seven- or eight-circuit connectors, while heavy road combinations may use seven-pole or fifteen-pole systems and separate ABS/EBS connections. SAE J560, SAE J1239, ISO 12098 and related specifications address different vehicle classes and duties; they are not interchangeable labels. We confirm plug and receptacle family, viewing direction, keying, circuit designation, system voltage, ground strategy, current and any data pair before drawing release.
copy.zh: 轻型拖车可能使用四、五、七或八回路接口，重型道路组合则可能采用七芯或十五芯系统，并设置独立 ABS/EBS 连接。SAE J560、SAE J1239、ISO 12098 等规范面向不同车辆级别与任务，不能混为同一种接口标签。图纸放行前需确认插头与插座家族、视图方向、防错、回路名称、系统电压、接地策略、电流及数据线对。

copy.en: Rear views, wire-side views and mating-face views can reverse a pin map.
copy.zh: 尾部视图、进线侧视图与对插面视图可能造成针位镜像。

copy.en: The customer and destination market define which interface and revision apply.
copy.zh: 由客户和目标市场确定适用接口与版本。

title.en: Lighting branches are organised by function, side, body length and replaceable lamp zone
title.zh: 灯光分支按功能、左右侧、车体长度与可更换灯区组织

copy.en: Tail, stop, turn, reverse, marker, clearance, licence, fog and work lamps can create repeated connectors along a long chassis. Circuit identity, left-right separation, branch station, ground return and connector orientation must remain unambiguous. Splice locations are kept away from water traps and service damage, while lamp pigtails provide controlled replacement length without leaving unsupported loops near tyres or moving doors.
copy.zh: 尾灯、制动灯、转向灯、倒车灯、侧标志灯、示廓灯、牌照灯、雾灯与工作灯会在长底盘上形成大量重复接口。回路身份、左右侧、分支站位、接地回流与连接器方向必须清晰；接续点避开积水和维修损伤区域，灯具尾线保留受控更换长度，同时避免在轮胎或运动门体附近形成无支撑余环。

copy.en: Position and function remain readable even when connectors look identical.
copy.zh: 即使连接器外观相同，位置与功能仍应可识别。

copy.en: Dedicated and chassis returns are documented rather than assumed.
copy.zh: 专用回线与车架回流必须被记录，不能凭经验假设。

title.en: Brake, axle and ABS/EBS circuits require separate control of safety, motion and diagnosis
title.zh: 制动、车轴与 ABS/EBS 回路需要分别控制安全、运动与诊断要求

copy.en: Electric brake feeds, breakaway switches, wheel-speed sensors, modulators and ABS/EBS power or data circuits vary by trailer class and region. Harnesses at axle and suspension zones experience movement, spray, stone impact and maintenance activity. Route, slack, clip spacing and connector support are checked through suspension travel and steering where applicable. Network construction and termination follow the approved system, and safety functions remain traceable from the tow interface to each device.
copy.zh: 电制动供电、脱离制动开关、轮速传感器、调制器以及 ABS/EBS 电源或数据回路会随拖车级别与地区变化。车轴与悬架区域线束承受运动、飞溅、碎石冲击与维修作业，因此要结合悬架行程及适用时的转向运动检查走线、余量、卡扣间距与接口支撑；网络结构与终端服从批准系统，安全功能从牵引接口到每个设备都保持可追溯。

copy.en: A correct conductor count does not prove ABS/EBS network compatibility.
copy.zh: 芯数正确并不能证明 ABS/EBS 网络兼容。

copy.en: Neutral-position slack alone cannot validate an axle branch.
copy.zh: 仅看静止位置余量不能验证车轴分支。

title.en: Charging, hydraulics, liftgates and refrigeration need their own power and protection budgets
title.zh: 充电、液压、尾板与冷藏设备需要独立供电和保护预算

copy.en: Auxiliary circuits can supply a breakaway battery, battery charging, hydraulic pump, electric landing gear, winch, liftgate, powered ramp, reefer unit, HVAC, interior lighting, cameras or telematics. Conductor size is derived from continuous and inrush current, total route length, allowable voltage drop, ambient temperature and terminal limits. Fuse or breaker position, return conductor, isolation and disconnect serviceability are reviewed as a complete circuit rather than treating a heavy cable as sufficient evidence.
copy.zh: 辅助回路可为脱离制动电池、蓄电池充电、液压泵、电动支腿、绞盘、尾板、动力坡道、冷藏机组、空调、内部照明、摄像头或车联网设备供电。导体截面依据持续与冲击电流、完整路径长度、允许压降、环境温度及端子限制确定；保险或断路器位置、回流导体、隔离和断开维修性作为完整回路审核，不能只凭粗线判断足够。

copy.en: Supply and return paths both add resistance, heat and voltage drop.
copy.zh: 供电与回流路径都会增加电阻、发热与压降。

copy.en: Protection location and rating follow the smallest released branch.
copy.zh: 保护位置与额定值服从下游最小放行分支。

title.en: Long rails, drawbars, axles, doors and sliding structures each create a different movement problem
title.zh: 长车架、牵引杆、车轴、车门与滑动结构分别形成不同运动问题

copy.en: Trailer routes can cross the drawbar, landing gear, suspension, sliding axle, dump hinge, tipper body, folding ramp, roll-up door or telescoping section. The design identifies fixed and moving ends, bend direction, full travel, twist, unsupported mass, rub points, hot surfaces and service positions. Clips, edge protection, grommets, conduits and controlled loops keep the harness clear of tyres, brakes, sharp steel and cargo mechanisms without making the assembly unnecessarily rigid.
copy.zh: 拖车走线可能经过牵引杆、支腿、悬架、滑动车轴、自卸铰链、翻斗车体、折叠坡道、卷帘门或伸缩结构。设计要识别固定端与运动端、弯曲方向、完整行程、扭转、无支撑重量、摩擦点、高温表面及维修位置；卡扣、护边、护圈、波纹管与受控余环使线束避开轮胎、制动器、锐利钢边和货物机构，同时避免把组件做得过硬。

copy.en: Branch stations are measured from defined frame or body references.
copy.zh: 分支站位从指定车架或车体参考面测量。

copy.en: Full extension, closure, tilt and service positions are all reviewed.
copy.zh: 完整伸展、关闭、倾翻与维修位置均需审核。

title.en: Water, road salt, mud, UV and washdown are treated as local exposure zones
title.zh: 把水、道路盐、泥浆、紫外线与冲洗作为局部暴露分区

copy.en: The front coupling, underbody, wheel zones, rear crossmember, boat-launch area and door interfaces do not face the same exposure. Housing, terminals, plating, wire seals, cavity plugs, locks, mating parts, backshells and cable exits must form one compatible system. Routing should avoid upward-facing cavities and water traps, coverings need drainage and controlled overlaps, and corrosion-sensitive joints require approved surfaces and assembly practice. Terminal grease is applied only when the connector specification and process permit it.
copy.zh: 前端连接、底部、轮区、后横梁、船用下水区域与车门接口面对的暴露并不相同。壳体、端子、镀层、线封、堵头、锁止、对插件、尾壳与出线必须构成相容体系；走线避免朝上的孔腔与积水，覆盖层需要排水和受控搭接，易腐蚀接点采用批准接触面与装配工艺。端子润滑脂仅在连接器规范与工艺允许时使用。

copy.en: Trapped water can defeat otherwise suitable components.
copy.zh: 积水会让原本合适的部件失效。

copy.en: Correct seals depend on terminal, cavity and wire-diameter compatibility.
copy.zh: 正确密封取决于端子、孔位与线外径兼容。

title.en: Conductor, insulation, jacket and covering follow the duty of each trailer zone
title.zh: 导体、绝缘、护套与覆盖层服从各拖车区域任务

copy.en: A trailer may combine automotive primary wire, jacketed multi-conductor cable, balanced data pairs, coaxial leads and high-current battery cable. TXL, GXL, SXL or other specified constructions are selected only where project and market requirements support them. Temperature, flex, fluid, abrasion, UV and installation method guide insulation and jacket choice. Conduit, braid, tape, heat shielding and grommets add different protections and are transitioned so that their cut edges do not concentrate bending or abrade the cable beneath.
copy.zh: 同一拖车可能同时使用汽车低压线、多芯护套电缆、平衡数据线对、同轴引线与大电流蓄电池线。TXL、GXL、SXL 或其他指定结构仅在项目与市场要求适用时选用。温度、弯折、液体、耐磨、紫外线及安装方式影响绝缘和护套选择；波纹管、编织网、胶带、隔热层与护圈承担不同防护任务，并通过受控过渡避免切口集中弯折或磨伤内部线缆。

copy.en: Signal, lighting and high-current branches need not share one wire family.
copy.zh: 信号、灯光与大电流分支不必使用同一线材家族。

copy.en: Covering ends and splices receive support and bend relief.
copy.zh: 覆盖层端部与接续点需要支撑和弯曲缓解。

title.en: Terminals, seals, splices and molded interfaces are engineered as production processes
title.zh: 端子、密封、接续与注塑接口都要作为制造工艺设计

copy.en: Trailer assemblies can use molded flat plugs, round multi-pole connectors, sealed automotive housings, lamp pigtails, ring terminals, fuse holders, junction boxes and overmolded splitters. Each terminal must match wire construction, seal range, cavity and mating contact. Open-barrel crimps, closed-barrel lugs, ultrasonic joints or other approved splices need defined preparation, tooling, acceptance criteria and strain relief. Overmolding can add sealing and pull support, but it does not correct an incompatible terminal or cable interface.
copy.zh: 拖车组件可能使用注塑扁平插头、圆形多芯接口、密封汽车连接器、灯具尾线、环形端子、保险座、接线盒与注塑分线器。每个端子都要匹配线材结构、线封范围、孔位和对插接触件；开口压接、闭口线鼻、超声波接续或其他批准接续需要规定剥线、工装、验收标准与应力缓解。注塑可以增加密封与拉力支撑，但不能修正不相容的端子或线缆接口。

copy.en: Wire, seal, terminal, cavity and mating contact are reviewed together.
copy.zh: 线材、线封、端子、孔位与对插接触件一并审核。

copy.en: Crimps and splices are verified before housings, tape or molding hide them.
copy.zh: 压接与接续在壳体、胶带或注塑遮蔽前完成核验。

title.en: Existing samples can guide replacement development without copying unknown faults
title.zh: 现有样品可支持替换开发，但不能把未知缺陷一并复制

copy.en: A sample can reveal plug family, branch length, lamp stations, clips, coverings and many point-to-point circuits. It may also contain corrosion, crushed cable, roadside repairs, missing grounds, substituted lamps or option-specific wiring. We document sample condition, trace circuits, identify mating equipment, compare vehicle and body information and isolate every uncertainty. Approved corrections and substitutions become controlled drawing revisions before a first article is installed and functionally reviewed.
copy.zh: 样品可以呈现插头家族、分支长度、灯具站位、卡扣、覆盖层与许多点对点回路，也可能带有腐蚀、压伤、路边维修、缺失接地、替换灯具或特定选装布线。我们会记录样品状态、追踪回路、识别对插设备、对照车辆与车体资料并隔离每项不确定性；批准修正与替代在首件装车和功能审核前转化为受控图纸版本。

copy.en: Repairs and missing protection are recorded rather than reproduced.
copy.zh: 维修痕迹与缺失防护被记录，而不是被复制。

copy.en: Body length, axle set, lamps and options remain tied to the released sample.
copy.zh: 车体长度、车轴组、灯具与选装始终关联放行样品。

title.en: Repeat production depends on controlled circuit identity, geometry and evidence
title.zh: 重复生产依赖受控回路身份、几何与证据

copy.en: Released drawings, pin and circuit tables, BOMs, cut lists, splice maps, form-board datums, work instructions and test definitions control production. Wire preparation, seal loading, crimping, splicing, connector insertion, locks, coverings, clips and labels receive staged checks before hidden. Routine inspection can verify dimensions, materials, cavity population, continuity, shorts and workmanship. Pull, resistance, voltage drop, insulation, sealing, flex, salt, thermal or vibration tests are added only against approved limits, and powered trailer checks confirm agreed functions separately.
copy.zh: 放行图纸、针脚与回路表、物料表、裁线表、接续图、布线板基准、作业指导与测试定义共同控制生产。剥线、穿线封、压接、接续、插壳、锁止、覆盖、卡扣与标签在被遮蔽前分阶段检查。常规检验可核对尺寸、物料、装针、导通、短路与工艺；拉力、电阻、压降、绝缘、密封、弯折、盐、温度或振动测试仅按批准限值增加，上电拖车检查则单独确认约定功能。

copy.en: Continuity, environmental validation and complete vehicle function are different claims.
copy.zh: 导通、环境验证与完整车辆功能属于不同声明。

copy.en: Harness revision, body options, fixture and test record remain traceably linked.
copy.zh: 线束版本、车体选装、工装与测试记录保持可追溯关联。

q.en: Is a trailer harness a universal product?
q.zh: 拖车线束是通用产品吗？

a.en: No. It is a broad family of tow-interface, chassis, lighting, brake, axle, auxiliary and equipment harnesses. Market, connector, voltage, trailer geometry, loads and installed options determine the released version.
a.zh: 不是。它是由牵引接口、底盘、灯光、制动、车轴、辅助与设备线束组成的广泛家族，市场、连接器、电压、拖车几何、负载与安装选项共同决定放行版本。

q.en: Can two seven-pin trailer plugs use the same pinout?
q.zh: 两个七针拖车插头一定使用相同针脚定义吗？

a.en: Not by assumption. Seven-position interfaces can belong to different standards and vehicle classes. Mating family, viewing direction, pin assignment, voltage, current and circuit function must be verified.
a.zh: 不能直接假设。七位接口可能属于不同标准与车辆级别，必须核对对插家族、视图方向、针脚定义、电压、电流与回路功能。

q.en: Does a sealed connector make the complete harness waterproof?
q.zh: 使用密封连接器就能让整根线束防水吗？

a.en: No. Housing, terminal, seal, cavity plug, mating part, cable exit, splice construction, covering, drainage, routing and assembly quality must work together under a defined exposure and test condition.
a.zh: 不能。壳体、端子、线封、堵头、对插件、出线、接续结构、覆盖层、排水、走线与装配质量必须在规定暴露和测试条件下共同工作。

q.en: Can ABS or EBS wiring be combined with ordinary lighting circuits?
q.zh: ABS 或 EBS 布线可以按普通灯光回路处理吗？

a.en: Its architecture must be reviewed separately. Power, ground, data pair, termination, connector system and applicable vehicle requirements must match the approved ABS/EBS equipment.
a.zh: 其架构必须单独审核。电源、接地、数据线对、终端、连接器体系与适用车辆要求都要匹配批准的 ABS/EBS 设备。

q.en: Can you develop a replacement from an old trailer harness?
q.zh: 可以依据旧拖车线束开发替换件吗？

a.en: Yes, as one evidence source. Corrosion, repairs, missing parts, hidden materials and body-option differences still need review against the trailer, mating equipment and circuit information before release.
a.zh: 可以把旧样品作为一类证据，但腐蚀、维修、缺失部件、隐藏材料及车体选装差异仍需结合拖车、对插设备和回路资料审核后才能放行。

q.en: What should be provided for quotation and sampling?
q.zh: 报价与打样需要提供什么？

a.en: Send towing vehicle and trailer identity, destination market, connector and pin data, voltage, loads and protection, lighting and brake architecture, ABS/EBS and auxiliary equipment, drawings or sample, chassis route and movement photographs, dimensions, exposure, labels, quantity and required validation.
a.zh: 请提供牵引车与拖车身份、目标市场、连接器与针脚资料、电压、负载与保护、灯光与制动架构、ABS/EBS 及辅助设备、图纸或样品、底盘走线和运动照片、尺寸、暴露环境、标签、数量与所需验证。
